name: iso-desk
description: ISO Desk: a CRM for an MCA funder's ISO manager. Private desks on Cloudflare Pages + D1, a public demo, and a cron worker for phone alerts.

scripts.deploy: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name iso-desk-josh --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview: wrangler pages deploy public --project-name iso-desk-josh --branch book-roles
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply iso-desk-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.test: node scripts/smoke.js demo && node scripts/smoke.js live && node scripts/smoke.js team && node scripts/smoke.js rep && node scripts/test-import.js && node scripts/test-webpush.mjs && node alerts-worker/test-run.mjs && node scripts/test-book.mjs
